checks: The complete five-section delivery executes twice on PostgreSQL without resetting records or relationships.
Only fresh successful admin verification records the timestamp; failed registration and heartbeats do not invent or change it.
Custom AC name is saved on the existing profile; controller display-name edits preserve it and do not duplicate records.
OFF, Turbo, partial-field retention and duplicate/out-of-order protection use the real observation RPC.
Admin physical results persist on the same AC, retain manufacturer, reject stale edits, credentials and invalid temperature overrides.
Actual command RPC uses protocol/model/physical constraints, rejects stale profiles and preserves honest queued delivery.
Frontend and PostgreSQL resolve identical temperature, fan, feature and model constraints for every audited profile/model.
Matrix is a narrowly scoped database correction; IDs, asset tags and protocol remain stable, and another admin custom name/manufacturer is preserved.
Non-admin and anonymous callers cannot save verification results.
